programme.title: When Duty Calls
programme.desc: Newlyweds Ellie and Martin move in with her parents while she waits for a job on the local police force. Their relationship is strained when Ellie, who had been working to solve a string of robberies, learns that Martin has been offered a job in Maine.

programme.title: The Last Cowboy
programme.desc: A woman returns home to Texas after an eight-year absence to claim the ranch her grandfather left to her in his will. Unfortunately, she has to somehow bridge the generation gap when she finds herself at loggerheads with her father.

programme.title: Wedding Daze
programme.desc: Amiable family farce centers around the put-upon parents (John Larroquette, Karen Valentine) of three brides planning simultaneous nuptials. French Stewart, Marina Black. Teri: Jaime Ray Newman. Dahlia: Kelly Overton. Sam: Sebastian Tillinger. Lyle: James Waterston. Jake: Marc Hershon.

programme.title: Puppy Love
programme.desc: Neighbors form an unusual arrangement to share custody of a dog, and the pair soon find themselves falling for one another.

programme.title: After the Fall
programme.desc: A talented equestrian (Andrea Bowen) is paralyzed after an accident and must go through physical therapy in hopes of someday walking again. During the recovery process, she befriends a rough-around-the-edges patient (Fiona Dourif) and her neighbor (Rick Malambri), a former rodeo cowboy who encourages her to return to horseback riding. Directed by Bradford May.

programme.title: Though None Go with Me
programme.desc: Elizabeth Leroy devotes her life to serving God but her faith is tested over the years as she has to overcome many hardships and sorrows.

programme.title: It Had to Be You
programme.desc: An ad exec whose boutique agency was swallowed up by her powerful father's firm, begrudgingly becomes attracted to the office rival she's force to work with on an important account.

programme.title: Always and Forever
programme.desc: Former high-school sweethearts Grace and Michael (Rena Sofer and Dean McDermott) reconnect at their 20-year high-school reunion. Sparks fly, but the pair are hesitant to jump into a relationship that already failed once. Grace's mom (Barbara Eden), meanwhile, is quick to offer her two cents on her daughter's romantic woes. Max Gail and Rob Boltin also star. Directed by Kevin Connor.

programme.title: The Reading Room
programme.desc: Tale of a widower (James Earl Jones) who's determined to make a reading room available in the tough inner-city neighborhood where he and his wife grew up. Joanna Cassidy, Tim Reid, Georg Stanford Brown (who also directed).

programme.title: Mr. Write
programme.desc: When editor Dori meets her idol, romantic novelist Michael, she's crushed to learn he doesn't really believe in true love. But when Dori's own romance falls apart, only Michael can pick up the pieces and renew her belief in love and in him.

programme.title: A Stranger's Heart
programme.desc: Samantha Mathis plays Callie, the recipient of a long-awaited heart transplant whose cynical attitude dissipates as she longs for a connection with her donor's orphaned daughter. Peter Dobson plays Callie's love interest and fellow transplant recipient, but it's Thomas Kopache who steals the show as her perennially grieving widowed father. Andy Wolk directed.

programme.title: The Yearling
programme.desc: A sensitive teenager grows up with a pet fawn in the Florida wilderness in the 1930s.

programme.title: Hidden Places
programme.desc: In 1930s California, a widowed farmer (Sydney Penny) tries to save her property from being seized by the bank with the help of a kindly drifter, who may be much more than he seems. Based on a novel by Lynn Austin.

programme.title: Twist of Fate
programme.desc: A man and a woman agree to meet after hitting it off on a phone call, but they keep missing each other for various reasons.

programme.title: Undercover Bridesmaid
programme.desc: A security agent goes undercover as a bridesmaid in order to protect a bride-to-be who's been receiving threatening letters leading up to her nuptials. As the agent works the case, she also forms a bond with a groomsman and learns a lesson about forgiveness.

programme.title: Woman of the House
programme.desc: A woman who feels nostalgic about her college sorority days takes a job as a house mother to her former chapter. Along with bringing out the best in the girls, she helps to turn the chapter around with the help of the charming Dean of Student Affairs.

programme.title: Expecting a Miracle
programme.desc: Botched directions lead a struggling couple (Teri Polo, Jason Priestley) to a small Mexican town whose residents have a positive effect on the pair's faltering marriage. Cheech Marin and Rebeka Montoya also star. Directed by Steve Gomer.

programme.title: Ice Dreams
programme.desc: An ex-Olympian (Jessica Cauffiel), who abandoned her figure-skating career following a tragic accident, reluctantly begins coaching an aspiring skater (Noelle Bruno). But their local practice rink could soon shut its doors for good as the new owner (Brady Smith) struggles to make ends meet. Jerry Stiller, Shelley Long and Kathleen Wilhoite also star. Directed by David Burton Morris.

programme.title: The Wish List
programme.desc: A perfectionist (Jennifer Esposito) makes a list of the qualities she's looking for in a mate and soon finds a seemingly ideal guy (Mark Deklin). But she's also drawn to a kooky barista (David Sutcliffe) who encourages her to loosen up and explore her creative side. Directed by Kevin Connor.

programme.title: A Time to Remember
programme.desc: An artist and single mother (Dana Delany) returns to her childhood home town for Thanksgiving to reconcile with her mother (Doris Roberts), who suffers from Alzheimer's.

programme.title: The Nanny Express
programme.desc: A spunky nanny (Vanessa Marcil) tries to win over her rebellious charges, who are coping with the death of their mother. Romance soon blooms between the nanny and the kids' father (Brennan Elliott), but the relationship could stall if the kids object. Dean Stockwell and Stacy Keach also star.

programme.title: The Seven Year Hitch
programme.desc: A slacker tries to prevent his best friend and roommate from marrying the wrong man by claiming their seven-year cohabitation makes them common-law spouses.

programme.desc: A young lawyer works for six weeks at a vineyard to inherit it.

programme.desc: A newly engaged woman makes a wish that her fiancé takes the planning of their wedding seriously, and to her surprise and dismay, her wish comes true.

programme.title: Though None Go with Me

programme.title: Wild Hearts
programme.desc: When Bob Hart, a widowed police detective trying to raise a rebellious teenage daughter, inherits a Montana horse ranch, he jumps at the opportunity to leave Los Angeles for the open range. Soon after arriving, Bob accepts the position as county sheriff and discovers that the seemingly bucolic countryside is far from tranquil. His problems include wolves who attack his stock, ruthless developers trying to take over the town and a female veterinarian with a chip on her shoulder.

programme.title: Diagnosis Delicious

programme.title: Love's Everlasting Courage
